ValidationRule.description: Compliance mega-rule: age math, ID format, shift minutes, salary log scale, email parity and skill counts, all together.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Contractor')), OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Birthdate__c)), YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Birthdate__c) > 75), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Employee_Id__c)), NOT(REGEX(Employee_Id__c, 'E[0-9]{6}'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Employee_Id__c)), MOD(VALUE(RIGHT(Employee_Id__c, 6)), 97) = 0, NOT(Is_Remote__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Salary__c)), Salary__c > 0, FLOOR(LOG(Salary__c)) < 4), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Bio__c)), LEN(Bio__c) > 2000, PICKLISTCOUNT(Skills__c) = 0), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Performance_Score__c)), OR(Performance_Score__c < 0, Performance_Score__c > 5, ROUND(Performance_Score__c * 2, 0) <> Performance_Score__c * 2)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Employee record failed the compliance audit.
